Subject: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro for MedPulse Health

Hi Elena — great speaking earlier this week. Thanks again for considering Redwood for the MedPulse pilot. Per our conversation, next steps to enable the AWS co-sell (ACE) path are: 

1) Submit ACE registration materials to AWS (we can initiate from our side or provide the form you can attach)
2) Quick intro between your technical lead and our PDM/PSM so we can map the proof-of-concept scope to ACE deliverables
3) Agree on a short MOSA (mutual action plan) and target kickoff date

I’ve attached the ACE registration form and a short SOC2 summary that AWS typically asks for. If you prefer, we can file the ACE registration on your behalf with an approval email from MedPulse.

Attachments:
- ace_registration_form.xlsx (xlsx)
- soc2_summary.pdf (pdf)

Would you be available for a 30-minute intro on Tuesday (4/30) at 10am PT to loop in our PDM/PSM? If that doesn’t work, share two windows that do.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0129
